t: Entity component system - Wikipedia
s: 1 week ago - ECS prioritizes composition over inheritance. Every entity is defined not by a type hierarchy, but by the components associated with it. Systems act globally over all entities that have the required components. For example, a food system might iterate through every entity with a relevant component tracking hunger, and act on them to push them a little away from satiation at time intervals.
